title: BLEND Digital Agency
description: At BLEND we are crafting custom experiences and interfaces in full life cycle from wireframe prototypes to high fidelity digital products like websites, web applications and mobile Apps. We combine Lean and Agile design processes based on methodologies like user-centered research, empathetic design, personas, storyboarding and other UX research methods to discover user needs and desires.

title: Northumbria University Newcastle
description: The MA Design Management program at Northumbria University Newcastle equips postgraduate students to harness design thinking, innovation, and creative leadership as strategic business tools within corporate and organizational contexts. Delivered by the university's School of Design, the curriculum bridges creative practice and strategic management, covering core areas such as design strategy, research methodologies, intellectual property, reflective practice, and commercialization. Tailored both for practicing designers aiming to transition into managerial roles and for business professionals seeking to leverage human-centered design, the course emphasizes multidisciplinary, real-world project work to drive organizational growth through product, service, and brand innovation.

title: Frederick University Nicosia
description: The BA in Graphic and Advertising Design is a 4-year undergraduate program designed to cultivate visual literacy, creative problem-solving, and strategic communication. Blending hands-on studio practice with theoretical inquiry, the curriculum covers key areas such as typography, corporate identity, campaign strategy, packaging design, digital media, and motion graphics. Through project-based learning and industry-linked assignments, the course emphasizes critical thinking, conceptual ideation, and mastery of modern design tools, preparing graduates for professional careers as graphic designers, art directors, branding specialists, and creative marketers across design studios and advertising agencies.
